evidence.quoted_text: dispatch_url="$(env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run install-matrix.yml --ref main)"
evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the install-matrix dispatch still runs `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run ...`, and the polling command also strips `GITHUB_TOKEN`. That removes a credential gh explicitly supports, so an operator authenticated only through `GITHUB_TOKEN` fails before dispatch. The pack-audit block retains the variable, confirming this is an existing command/documentation defect rather than a new requirement.
